name: 68826 · Central City, NE
findings: ZIP 68826 (Central City) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 68826 (Central City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
